<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="חשון_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518915043_theRebbe_419" batchId="meluket-_D7_97_D7_A9_D7_95_D7_9F_meluket__BH_POST_1766518915043_theRebbe_419__p002">
  <section v="3">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The soul requires garments of Torah and mitzvos to receive the radiance of the Divine Presence, since as a created being it cannot grasp the Ein Sof directly.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">3)</t>
    <t s="1">And this will be understood by first explaining the well-known concept</t>
    <t s="2">in this matter, that the soul needs the garments of Torah and mitzvos in order to be able to delight in the radiance of the Divine Presence,</t>
    <t s="3">because the soul is a created being</t>
    <t s="4">[and as explained in many places, the soul is like Divinity that has become in the aspect of a created being,</t>
    <t s="5">to the extent that its attachment to Divinity is an imperceptible attachment]</t>
    <t s="6">and it is impossible for a created being to attain any comprehension of the Ein Sof, blessed is He,</t>
    <t s="7">therefore, in order for the soul to delight in the radiance of the Divine Presence, which is an illumination from the Ein Sof, blessed is He,</t>
    <t s="8">[and especially to behold the pleasantness of Havayah],</t>
    <t s="9">it needs garments.</t>
    <t s="10">And this is analogous to a great light</t>
    <t s="11">[exceedingly so,</t>
    <t s="12">like the light of the sun,</t>
    <t s="13">the aspect of "the sun of Havayah"]</t>
    <t s="14">which one cannot look at,</t>
    <t s="15">but through a screen</t>
    <t s="16">(which is like a garment)</t>
    <t s="17">one can receive</t>
    <t s="18">[and absorb]</t>
    <t s="19">the light.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="4">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Torah and mitzvos serve as a mediating garment that connects the soul with the Divine radiance, because they contain both the aspect of the unlimited from their source and the aspect of limitation from their descent into the physical world.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And it is known</t>
    <t s="1">that any intermediary that connects two things</t>
    <t s="2">must be comprised of both of them.</t>
    <t s="3">From this, it is also understood regarding the garments of Torah and mitzvos</t>
    <t s="4">[which are like an intermediary connecting the aspect of the radiance of the Divine Presence</t>
    <t s="5">(which is an illumination from the Ein Sof, blessed is He, without limit)</t>
    <t s="6">with the soul</t>
    <t s="7">(which is a created being and has a boundary)],</t>
    <t s="8">that they contain both aspects.</t>
    <t s="9">For their source</t>
    <t s="10">(of Torah and mitzvos)</t>
    <t s="11">is from His will and wisdom, blessed is He, which are unified with Him, blessed is He,</t>
    <t s="12">(for He</t>
    <t s="13">and His wisdom and will are one)</t>
    <t s="14">— an aspect of the unlimited</t>
    <t s="15">[to the extent that His will and wisdom, blessed is He,</t>
    <t s="16">(the source of Torah and mitzvos)</t>
    <t s="17">are above even the aspect of the radiance of the Divine Presence],</t>
    <t s="18">and by descending below into this physical world, into physical tzitzis made of physical wool and tefillin made of physical parchment, and likewise in all the mitzvos,</t>
    <t s="19">[and so too with Torah, which is clothed in human intellect,</t>
    <t s="20">even in arguments of falsehood,</t>
    <t s="21">and is clothed in ink on a book]</t>
    <t s="22">they are in the aspect of measurement and limitation, even to the measurement and limitation of this physical world, below which there is no lower level,</t>
    <t s="23">thus, through these two aspects within Torah and mitzvos</t>
    <t s="24">[the aspect of the unlimited within them from their source,</t>
    <t s="25">and the aspect of limitation within them from their descent below]</t>
    <t s="26">they become a garment and an intermediary connecting the soul, which is a created being and has a boundary,</t>
    <t s="27">(and as it is clothed in a physical body)</t>
    <t s="28">with the aspect of the radiance of the Divine Presence, and even with the aspect of the pleasantness of Havayah, which is above all measurement and limitation.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="5">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Because Torah and mitzvos are clothed in physical matters, they must be cleansed of any dross, and even after that, they require refinement through angels to ascend properly.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">4)</t>
    <t s="1">Now, due to the clothing of Torah and mitzvos in matters of this physical world, which is mostly evil,</t>
    <t s="2">they must be cleansed of any dross that falls into them,</t>
    <t s="3">as in the study of Torah,</t>
    <t s="4">that because the Torah is clothed in human intellect and in physical matters, it is possible</t>
    <t s="5">that one's study will be not for its own sake, even to the lowest level of not for its own sake,</t>
    <t s="6">and likewise with mitzvos.</t>
    <t s="7">And this is why the garments of Torah and mitzvos require washing and laundering,</t>
    <t s="8">so that they be clean garments, etc.</t>
    <t s="9">(and even if they are not in the manner of "garments of exile"),</t>
    <t s="10">similar to a physical garment, which in order to be pure and clean must be washed and laundered.</t>
    <t s="11">[And even after a person launders the garments of Torah and mitzvos so that they are clean of all dross, etc.,</t>
    <t s="12">in order for them to ascend above,</t>
    <t s="13">they need to be refined by the angels,</t>
    <t s="14">who "embrace them and kiss them."</t>
    <t s="15">And the explanation is that it is written,</t>
    <t s="16">"There is no righteous person on earth who does good and does not sin,"</t>
    <t s="17">for because a person is on earth in this physical world, therefore he has sin,</t>
    <t s="18">"sin" meaning deficiency</t>
    <t s="19">(at least).</t>
    <t s="20">And although the sin</t>
    <t s="21">(the deficiency)</t>
    <t s="22">is not due to his fault, G-d forbid,</t>
    <t s="23">for "all Your people are righteous,"</t>
    <t s="24">but rather as it is said,</t>
    <t s="25">"Awesome in deed upon mankind," that the Holy One, blessed is He, desires that people exist in such a world,</t>
    <t s="26">[similar to</t>
    <t s="27">a king who sent his son to a distant country in order to demonstrate his son's wisdom, that even in the distant country he would recognize the truth,</t>
    <t s="28">the aspect of "the truth of Havayah is forever"],</t>
    <t s="29">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="30">since in actuality there is in him</t>
    <t s="31">(sin meaning)</t>
    <t s="32">a deficiency,</t>
    <t s="33">and also his Torah and mitzvos are not perfect,</t>
    <t s="34">as it is written, "There is no righteous person on earth who does good and does not sin,"</t>
    <t s="35">that the deficiency</t>
    <t s="36">("does not sin")</t>
    <t s="37">is also in his Torah and mitzvos</t>
    <t s="38">("who does good")</t>
    <t s="39">of his,</t>
    <t s="40">therefore, in order for his Torah and mitzvos to ascend above,</t>
    <t s="41">he needs the assistance of the angels].</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
